# ShipRepair

Fixes to Monolith's ship repair device (SRD) so it can rebuild Wolfgate hulls. A hull that breaks apart keeps its
repair snapshot on every piece, an original entity only blocks a rebuild when it still sits on the target grid, and
admin-spawned vessels get a snapshot like bought ones.

Entry points: `ShipRepairSystem.WFSplit` (copies the snapshot on grid split) and the marked edits in
`SharedShipRepairSystem.Tool` and `AdminVesselSpawnSystem`.
